event.text: You can start self-care now: avoid bending the wrist while sleeping (a neutral wrist splint at night helps), take breaks from repetitive hand use, and track which fingers are affected. This pattern, worse at night, often comes from nerve compression at the wrist. If you develop hand weakness, dropping things, constant numbness, or any face droop, slurred speech or arm weakness, call 911. If symptoms persist beyond a few weeks or worsen, message a Counsel clinician in this thread for review.
